verdict: Actual original lowD ALIGN first4 independently passed joint-region/safety checks; no full-demo or gain production adoption claim

native_FAST_IMU.limits: Only native integrator log head timestamps recovered by documented first LiDAR origin; <=2ns log representation quantized for 1ms input coverage, never state interpolation or correction.

footer.scope:
Passive bounded CDR suffix, not a controller. No body/goal/pose publishers.

Every message is serialized with its complete original ROS schema. Total
received counts and DDS loss diagnostics are separate from retained suffix
coverage. output.effort in JTC state is commanded effort, not applied torque.
evidence_limits: Suffix only; count alone does not prove a time window is covered.
Require each relevant stream to bracket the entire fourth-goal interval or mark that evidence incomplete.
output.effort is commanded effort, not independently measured applied torque.
No headers are invented and no body/pose/control messages are published.

limits: CDR retains all original fields; selected original payloads were decoded without altering messages.
Sparse contact header gaps are not invented empty-contact records or proof of a missed publisher frame.
Header continuity is observed state-publication evidence, not a native ControllerInterface::trigger_update capture.
JTC output.effort is commanded effort; actual JointState effort zero is not proof of zero applied torque.
Legacy JSB effort NaN is unavailable measurement, preserved as unavailable rather than an invalid payload or zero torque.
Output command exceeding URDF effort does not establish actual applied force, actuator clipping or its causal role.
Headerless command and Pose use recorder latest /clock association, not an invented exact simulation publication stamp.

actual_ALIGN_configuration.scope: Actual NAV final audit and received live status configuration, not commanded plant response

limits: One actual initial SE3 used only for evaluation; no GT/SLAM state correction feeds controller and no later receipt replaces any original window.
Every observed native-input/recorder missing stamp is retained separately; current SLAM accuracy does not repair consumption omissions.
Headers prove observed state-message coverage, not actual ControllerInterface trigger period or applied hardware torque.
Startup earlyRPC/maps and final runtime/source are separate certificates, both required.
Actual first4 scope only; no first8/dynamic or full46-route completion is inferred.
